decisions.name: Bo
decisions.reason: The only ambiguous prior match is a country-code filename: BO denotes Bolivia, while the immutable WUP settlement is Bo in Sierra Leone (SL). The retained first-party GeoServer response has Bolivian rural features in Beni/Tarija, far from the WUP Bo point. The Bolivia country packet is not a Bo city investigation. Keep the WUP identity unchanged and queue Bo for its own research; no parcel discovery or absence is inferred for Bo.
